profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. According to its website, the company supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, and it says these offerings are meant to support innovation across the semiconductor industry. The site also discusses how TSMC and its business model accelerate innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and how the company contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, trading under the ticker TSM, and its website is tsmc.com. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001046179.

No AI-specific products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
